For teachers and tutors

About Read the List

A price list reading game, like a menu or a shop board. Rounds ask "How much is the bread?", "Which one is cheaper?" or "Which one is more expensive?". The items are everyday groceries at believable prices.

How to play

  1. Read the price list.
  2. Read the question.
  3. Tap the answer.
